test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the wife of B

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’

Based on the above, how is O related to L if ‘O − M ÷ N + L’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Sister
 Mother 
 Daughter 
 
 

 

Given: O − M ÷ N + L

It means: O is the sister of M, M is the daughter of N, and N is the wife of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8f20d4750a351af9eb0215b3216b32a330340a86cd878b35f4749c02be7e5ca.png] 

So, O is the '**Daughter**' of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
